about: External tools Lamplight can accept output from. Lamplight stays small; big tools stay external — a bridge is one importer module plus one entry here. Bridges are built only when a real game needs one (the Law), so planned entries are honest labels, not promises.

tools.name: Krita / Aseprite-style spritesheet export
tools.lamplightAccepts: Not yet — bridge planned: Sheet/Animation loader for JSON atlases

tools.name: Tiled
tools.produces: Tile maps and object layers, exported as Tiled JSON
tools.lamplightAccepts: Not yet — bridge planned: Tiled JSON loader (layers, tilesets, spawn/object points)

tools.name: Godot (CozyDev)
tools.lamplightAccepts: Not a bridge — a separate lane. Porch Light's heavy projects live in Godot; Lamplight is the fast web lane. The catalogue lists both so each project starts on the right one.
